summary.jbook_hit_note: HII Navy SCN programs (Virginia, Columbia, CVN Ford, DDG-51, LHA/LPD, NSC) are NOT in the J-Book corpus per heuristic 7. The corpus is 410 RDT&E + Procurement PEs concentrated in DARPA/MDA/SOCOM/OSD/Air Force RDT&E I-IV/Space Force/AF Aircraft & Other Procurement. Navy SCN (Shipbuilding & Conversion, Navy) is a known structural coverage gap. All HII Navy SCN claims correctly mark UNVERIFIABLE rather than RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE.
summary.framework_validation_note: This run validates heuristic 7: the framework correctly suppresses false RED_FLAG signals when the corpus does not cover the relevant DoD account (Navy SCN). usaspending cross-check still provides orthogonal verification that HII genuinely receives the Navy SCN obligations they claim - $61.6B across 992 awards including $11.89B on CVN 80 alone.
